gameDescriptionHtml:
Welcome to “Before Fate”: A Nexus of Time and Space.

“Before Fate” blends retro sci-fi with imaginative comic art for a unique survival adventure. Journey through time portals, explore diverse worlds, gather resources, face survival challenges, explore mysterious dungeons, and gradually uncover the truth behind an interstellar disaster.

“The Nexus is a point where time and space converge, revealing endless possibilities and hopes. It is as brief and brilliant as a shooting star.”

In an era where robots coexist with humans, a meteor’s descent forebodes looming catastrophes. As scientist Ian Stewart, alongside the leader of the Aude team, Abel Morrison, venture into the marvel of time and space, exploring, battling, and unveiling the mysteries of the universe.

Cross the veil of time, explore endless possibilities, and make “Before Fate” your journey through time and space.

Join us in unraveling the world of “Before Fate”!

Game Features

  • Time-Space Odyssey: Explore diverse environments, from desolate deserts to mysterious forests. Each realm hides uncharted challenges and wonders.
  • Deep Narrative: Trace the enigmatic path of the Chrono Gem, collaborate with scientists from the Aude Research Institute to unlock the secrets of the universe and avert impending disasters.
  • Rich Arsenal: Craft your combat style with over a hundred types of weapons and numerous unique items, coloring each expedition with uniqueness.
  • Puzzle Challenges: Integrate intuitive UI with environmental interactions, where each puzzle sharpens your wit.
  • Tribute to Classics: Every frame pays homage to the modern reinterpretation of classics, saluting masters like Moebius.
  • Artistic Style: Retro Meets Modern: A blend of ’70s and ’80s sci-fi with comic styles, each pixel radiates with retro-futuristic charm. Hand-Drawn World: Carefully crafted scenes and characters depict a vibrant world brimming with life and imagination.
